versions.subject: Merge PR #4975 from @Murphy0801 - Add new rules related to GTFOBins
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/git'
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -p '
        - 'help'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'bash 0<&1'
        - 'dash 0<&1'
        - 'sh 0<&1'
condition: selection
